description: A gentle sloped 2.1 km (one way) trail that runs alongside the western shore of Allison Lake. The trail links the community of Allison Lake on the north shore to the Allison Lake Provincial Park day use area located on the southern shore of the lake. This trail is non-motorized. The trail should be traversed one way and then doubled back the same way. An additional 300 metres of the trail is found within the provincial park.
directions: 30 kms north of Princeton on Hwy # 5. Turn left off highway onto Sky Blue Loop Road and follow to the trailhead and parking area. The southern trailhead is located at the southern end of Allison Lake. Turn into the day use parking lot of the Allison Lake Provincial Park.
title: Allison Lake Trail
